connector.name: Google Health MCP
connector.registryDescription: Privacy-first unofficial Google Health API v4 MCP server for health, sleep, activity, HR agents
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package google-health-mcp-unofficial. Access is granted through an authorisation flow, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the davidmosiah account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: The record references an OAuth flow, so expect a browser consent step rather than a static key. Confirm the scopes on the consent screen before you approve.

env.name: GOOGLE_HEALTH_CLIENT_ID
env.description: Google Cloud OAuth client ID for Google Health API. Optional when configured with google-health-mcp-server setup.

env.name: GOOGLE_HEALTH_CLIENT_SECRET
env.description: Google Cloud OAuth client secret. Prefer google-health-mcp-server setup so this secret is stored in ~/.google-health-mcp/config.json instead of MCP client config.

env.name: GOOGLE_HEALTH_REDIRECT_URI
env.description: Redirect URI configured in the Google Cloud OAuth client. Optional when configured with google-health-mcp-server setup.

env.name: GOOGLE_HEALTH_TOKEN_PATH
env.description: Optional local path for OAuth tokens. Defaults to ~/.google-health-mcp/tokens.json.

env.name: GOOGLE_HEALTH_PRIVACY_MODE
env.description: Optional payload mode: summary, structured, or raw. Defaults to structured. raw means full Google Health API payloads, not continuous 24/7 raw sensor telemetry.

env.name: GOOGLE_HEALTH_CACHE
env.description: Optional SQLite cache toggle. Set to true or sqlite to enable.

env.name: GOOGLE_HEALTH_CACHE_PATH
env.description: Optional local SQLite cache path. Defaults to ~/.google-health-mcp/cache.sqlite.

env.name: GOOGLE_HEALTH_NO_CACHE
env.description: Set to true to bypass the in-memory HTTP response cache (60s TTL for GET only). POST/PUT/DELETE and 4xx/5xx responses are never cached regardless.
